mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a rising demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are increasing and the unemployment rate is declining (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is declining (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment growth rate and a low unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment growth is high and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index signals a decrease in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the consumer price index is declining (t-test p > 0.05).
